note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-2 Technical Manual TM 9-803, War Department, 1944, with the tier-5 English Wikipedia article retained for the fields the manual's degraded dimension rows do not give. The manual publishes the weight with fuel and water, the gross loaded weight, the ground clearance, the tyre size code and the approach and departure angles, all at grade documented. The Wikipedia article supplies the overall dimensions, the engine and the road speed at grade claimed.

curb_weight_kg.locator: Section II Description and Tabulated Data, section 3 Data, Vehicle Specifications, Weights, Road, including gas and water, printed page 3
curb_weight_kg.state: weight on the road including gas and water, published as 2,453 lb; pounds converted to kilograms, 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg

gross_weight_kg.locator: Section II Description and Tabulated Data, section 3 Data, Vehicle Specifications, Weights, Gross (loaded), printed page 3
gross_weight_kg.state: gross weight loaded, published as 3,253 lb; pounds converted to kilograms, 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg

length_mm.state: length published as 132 in; inches converted to millimetres; the tier-2 manual publishes the dimension in a row that is degraded in the held copy, so this weaker compilation value is retained and marked claimed

width_mm.state: width published as 62 in; inches converted to millimetres; the tier-2 manual dimension row is degraded in the held copy, so this weaker compilation value is retained and marked claimed

height_mm.locator: Infobox, height row, top up entry
height_mm.state: height published as 69 3/4 in with the top up, reducible to 52 in; inches converted to millimetres; the tier-2 manual dimension row is degraded in the held copy, so this weaker compilation value is retained and marked claimed

ground_clearance_mm.locator: Section II Description and Tabulated Data, section 3 Data, Vehicle Specifications, Ground clearance, printed page 3
ground_clearance_mm.state: ground clearance published as 8 3/4 in; inches converted to millimetres

tyre_size_text.locator: Section II Description and Tabulated Data, section 3 Data, Vehicle Specifications, Tire size, printed page 3
tyre_size_text.state: tyre size published as 16 x 6.00 in; the table also lists a 16 x 4.50 combat tyre

approach_angle_deg.locator: Section II Description and Tabulated Data, section 3 Data, Vehicle Specifications, Approach angle, printed page 3
approach_angle_deg.state: approach angle published as 45 deg, as published

departure_angle_deg.locator: Section II Description and Tabulated Data, section 3 Data, Vehicle Specifications, Departure angle, printed page 3
departure_angle_deg.state: departure angle published as 35 deg, as published

engine_model.state: engine published as a 134 cu in inline 4 Willys L134 Go Devil, as published; the tier-2 manual is held for the vehicle data only

engine_displacement_l.state: engine displacement published as 134 cu in; cubic inches converted to litres and rounded to the published precision 2.2 L; the tier-2 manual is held for the vehicle data only

published_power_hp.state: gross engine power published as 60 hp, with a 54 hp net rating; the gross figure recorded and the basis stated; maximum rating, no net basis; the tier-2 manual is held for the vehicle data only

transmission_type.state: transmission published as a 3-speed with a 2-range transfer case, a manual; the tier-2 manual is held for the vehicle data only

max_speed_kmh.state: speed published as 65 mph; miles per hour converted to km/h, 1 mph = 1.609344 km/h; the tier-2 manual is held for the vehicle data only
